summary: Build low-code automation skills for finance, HR, procurement, and operations. Map, govern, and deliver workflows with practical exercises. Enrol today.
lede: Digital workplace process automation for finance, HR, and procurement teams helps turn email- and spreadsheet-based work into structured, controlled workflows. You will learn to map processes with BPMN 2.0 and SIPOC, clarify ownership and exceptions, identify controls, and assess where low-code automation can add value. The course guides you through designing Power Automate flows, specifying Power Apps forms, planning SharePoint or Dataverse data structures, and creating measurement and governance artefacts. You will practise developing evidence-based delivery cases for approvals, employee requests, purchase requisitions, records management, and other administrative processes while accounting for data quality, legacy systems, approval hierarchies, cybersecurity concerns, and user adoption.
audienceIntro: Digital workplace automation training suits professionals who own, analyse, govern, or sponsor administrative workflows and need practical low-code delivery skills without becoming software developers.
prerequisites: You should have working experience with at least one administrative, finance, HR, procurement, or shared-services process. No programming experience is required. Familiarity with spreadsheets, digital collaboration tools, or organisational approval procedures will help, but the course introduces the relevant BPMN 2.0 and Microsoft Power Platform concepts. Advanced topics such as AI Builder, process mining, and integration architecture receive conceptual or operational coverage rather than technical engineering treatment.
